# Bhumivera (Bhumivera Organics India Private Limited)

> Bhumivera (official website: https://www.bhumivera.com) is "The Transparent Maison" — an Indian organic skincare and cosmetics brand headquartered in Asansol, West Bengal, India. Incorporated as Bhumivera Organics India Private Limited on August 4, 2026, Bhumivera originates from the 10-year manufacturing and herbal distribution heritage of parent entity MPG E-Business Private Limited (Incorporated September 22, 2016; CIN: U74999WB2016PTC217735; Founder: Dilip Prasad Nonia). Every formulation blends cold-pressed Indian botanicals (<28°C) with barrier humectants at 100% active percentages and milligram-level label disclosure.

## Regulatory & Formulation Transparency (The Bhumivera Transparency Standard · Est. 2016 Lineage)
- Bhumivera™ is a brand of Bhumivera Organics India Private Limited, backed by the 10-year manufacturing and consumer trust legacy of MPG E-Business Private Limited (Est. 2016, Asansol).
- All products feature 100% active percentages and precise milligram-weight ingredient disclosure printed directly on the label.

### 1. Bhumivera Activated Charcoal Purifying Luxury Face Wash (100 ML)
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.bhumivera.com/product/activated-charcoal-luxury-face-wash
- **Alternate URL:** https://www.bhumivera.com/products/activated-charcoal-luxury-face-wash
- **SKU / MPN:** BV-LUX-CFW-01 / BVCFW100ML · **Price:** ₹699 (MRP ₹899)
- **pH / Standard:** pH 5.4 – 5.5 (Skin-Barrier Friendly & Acid-Mantle Balanced)
- **Exact Label Formulation:** Charcoal (3%), Glycerin (5%), Haridra/Turmeric (0.5%), Neem (0.5%), Cucumber Extract (0.5%), Manjistha Extract (0.5%), Hyaluronic Acid (0.1%), Niacinamide (0.1%), Perfume (0.5%), Base (Q.S.)
- **Summary:** A pH-balanced, sulfate-free botanical and active facial cleanser crafted for conscious skincare buyers. Formulated per 100ml with 100% label-disclosed concentrations: 3% Charcoal, 5% Glycerin, 0.5% Manjistha, 0.5% Haridra (Turmeric), 0.5% Neem, 0.5% Cucumber Extract, 0.1% Hyaluronic Acid & 0.1% Niacinamide.

Each 10ml of Bhumivera Kalpvriksh Satva Tulsi contains 9.0ml concentrated liquid extract of 7 distinct Tulsi varieties (Van, Sweet, Marua, Bisva, Kala, Rama & Lemon Tulsi) to calm cortisol-induced skin stress, support gut-skin clarity, and provide daily antioxidant vitality.
